rank.condition_rule: sigma_max/sigma_min; deficient = null with reason RANK_DEFICIENT (mathematical infinity)
rank.sensitivity: raw plus nominal scaled; one state/input scale at a time x0.1 and x10; continuous tau=0.1,1,10 s

finite_difference.scheme: central differences of independently implemented matching NumPy f/F
finite_difference.rule: abs(J-Dh)<=abs_tol+rel_tol*max(abs(J),abs(Dh)); also two smallest Dh agree by same rule
finite_difference.boundaries: No clamp, no silent step adjustment; unavailable or explicitly one-sided at knot/wrap/domain boundary

PBH.continuous: full row rank at every eigenvalue Re(lambda)>=0
PBH.discrete: full row rank at every eigenvalue |lambda|>=1
PBH.ambiguous_result: INDETERMINATE; Schur/staircase/residual follow-up, no favorable classification

closed_loop.products: Phi(k,j)=Acl[k-1]...Acl[j]; Phi(j,j)=I; all covered subintervals within original remaining packet
measures: full six-state coupled and conditional scalar speed results

Riccati.denominator: max(1,sum of Frobenius norms of equation terms)
Riccati.on_failure: Preserve original gains; stop affected certificate/reproduction, do not retune

response_sampling.clock: native physical event/plant sample times; no visual interpolation for extrema
response_sampling.errors: actual minus active packet reference, heading wrapped on local chart; also original fixed packet within validity in ModeB where available
response_sampling.integrals: sum abs(e_i)*(t_next-t_i), sum e_i^2*(t_next-t_i); last sample has no extrapolated interval
response_sampling.handoff: split windows by authority; retain jump and distinguish original-feedback from post-replacement behavior
response_sampling.peak: max absolute error; earliest tie time; report initial value and sign; overshoot opposite initial signed displacement normalized by increment when meaningful, otherwise null
response_sampling.settling: First native sample such that every regulated component remains inside its absolute band for >=0.2 s AND through the entire remaining observed window. Report individual and joint settling, duration and relative-to-injection time. At least 0.2 s subsequent data required. No progress settling claim.
response_sampling.censoring: If unsettled or insufficient dwell at packet expiry/observation limit/domain stop/budget, settling_time=null, right_censored=true, lower_bound=observed duration if no qualifying entry; distinguish no observed settling from instability. Domain termination is failure plus truncated/censored response, not missing favorable trial.
response_sampling.oscillation: sign changes outside declared bands, peak ordering/amplitude and timing; short records give descriptive counts only; no inferred asymptotic frequency
response_sampling.finite_horizon_amplification: max scaled norm(e(t))/scaled norm(initial error) if nonzero; normalized-by-injected increment also reported with defect/baseline caveat

effort_and_validity: max and integrated delta, delta-nominal correction
actual application steering TV=sum abs(delta_j-delta_(j-1)); rates use actual application intervals, ties explicit
box/slew saturation duration and counts; pending/held/request/applied identity
max acceleration/braking, acceleration variation, speed error and extrema
front/rear force/load/slip/combined utilization and longitudinal reserve
min D, speed and actuator-domain margins, physical center clearance, corridor/slack margins
packet expiry, acceptance/rejection, fallback, planner misses and codriver misses separately
estimation timestamp and age only if separately specified

claim_levels.1: Mathematical/local conditioned evidence only; currently analytic derivation without evaluated matrices
claim_levels.2: Empirical finite-horizon synthetic observations only; NOT EXECUTED
claim_levels.3: Formal guarantee only with explicit hypotheses and actual proof; NONE supplied

forbidden_inferences: full-rank linear pair implies constrained nonlinear controllability
stable frozen matrices imply stable time-varying products
successful solver alone implies valid packet
simulation stop implies physical safe stopping
baseline_limit: No paired zero-disturbance simulations in 80/32 caps; no causal incremental-rejection or timing-equivalent sensitivity claim from archived divergent baseline.
